description: Compound scenario bankability model for a 1 GW solar PV project in Nigeria is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley Data. This dataset is the live spreadsheet model behind the compound bankability analysis reported in the related article on a proposed 1 GW utility-scale solar photovoltaic project in the Federal Capital Territory of Nigeria. Coverage: Nigeria. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley Data. Its tags are Solar Energy, Energy Policy, Renewable Energy. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial No Derivatives 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
